notes: Piece P5 (the Presidio, middle). Box moved from 1220,1700,690,700: left side 20 px right (x0 1240, w 670) so it clears the road at x 1200-1236, y 1995-2105, which otherwise left a 5-px sliver of land inside the box. A few px of line ink outside the strokes there come out street. Small solid black triangle at x 1858-1866, y 1882-1897, standing free in the fork where the loop road meets the diagonal road: read as a traffic island and marked open; it may instead be an arrow mark. Tiny oval interior at x 1508-1514, y 1700-1704, cut by the box top: a traffic island, marked open. Dead-end road ending in a closed U at 1520,1983 (x 1495-1525, y 1920-1985) is street. The pointed corner at 1530-1545, 2033-2037 is where two road lines meet; nothing done. The lettering 1300, PRESIDIO and the P at 1870-1910, 1985-2030 lie in land and take the land's colour. No city blocks in the box.
